chapter_summary: Shen Feizhi successfully secures a job as a "Cleaning Supervisor" at the W.N. research institute using a fabricated identity, "Shen Zhi." He then makes a significant amount of money through short-term stock market trading. Realizing it's Friday and he's forgotten about Gu Suizhou, who is now out of school, he rushes back to the First District. Meanwhile, Gu Suizhou, abandoned by Shen Feizhi, is waiting outside his school, High Tier High School, with his friend Song Zhe. His backstory reveals he's playing the role of a "helpless waste" to protect his inheritance from his deceased father, Gu Lang, which is currently under the guardianship of Lin Sui. Gu Suizhou is confronted by a bully, Yang Rui. Shen Feizhi arrives just in time to intervene, stopping Yang Rui from hitting Gu Suizhou and then stomping on Yang Rui's injured hand.
